body:
## Context
`internal/memory/importer` (+ `codexmemory`) and `internal/memory/activity` are Go-only; MIGRATION-RUST.md notes DB-backed activity commands still delegate until the memory SQLite phase.

## Scope
- Port importers and the activity store with Go-oracle fixtures; local `evidencekit` port from the memory store issue is reused.

## Acceptance
- Importer/activity differentials pass on native three-OS CI.

**Blocked by:** #758

---
**Part of:** #731
**Agent notes:** work in an isolated worktree off current `main`; read `AGENTS.md` and the migration ledger first. Until Go is removed, parity evidence must come from real Go-oracle fixtures generated in disposable HOME/XDG roots (no operator credentials). Update the ledger/contract-matrix rows touched by this issue in the same PR. Skipped, zero-case or cross-compiled-only runs are not evidence.
title: memory: port importers (incl. codexmemory) and the DB-backed activity store
